piece of armour. | id = MoldArmorGoldLegs | type = Mould | source = [[Krigen]] | usage = Crafting | weight = 1.0 | stack = 10 }} }} }} The '''Protector Armor''' is a [[Deep North]]-tier [[armor]]. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces. The pieces cannot be crafted directly. Instead the player must craft the corresponding [[Cast]] at a level 4 [[Black Forge]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]], which takes 50 seconds and five [[Liquid Frost]]. The pieces are repaired at a level 4 Black Forge. The finished pieces are upgraded at the Black Forge, from level 5 for quality 2 up to level 7 for quality 4. The [[Forge of Potential]] upgrade for the Breastplate and Trousers uses a [[Bloodgold Protection Idol]]. None of the pieces reduce movement speed. The {{Item Link|Breastplate of the Protector}} makes the wearer [[Resistance|resistant]] vs. [[Frost]]. === Moulds === Each cast needs the matching mould. The three moulds are dropped by [[Krigen]], each with a 3% chance (6% for one-star and 12% for two-star Krigen). === Quality === 1= === Quality 1 === Black Forge level: 4 (cast)
